product.title: Hidden Craters Hike of Kona

description.text: Join the Hidden Craters Hike for a Big Island off-road climb and hike up the cool and misty slopes of Hualalai volcano above Kona. 4 Wheel Drive vans carry you up most of the way to 6,000 feet elevation before you begin your on-foot ascent through lava flows and a forest full of native birdsong. Stops include Hawaii Forest & Trail Headquarters, Hualalai Volcano Slopes, Native Cloud Forest Trail, Volcanic Craters and Fissures, Lava Tube. This adventure tour teaches you all about the best of Kona's volcanic highlands. Ideal for visitors basing in Kona who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
